g.text: SQRlane does the desk work itself.
Every mail read once. Sixteen agents do the work. Nothing leaves without you.
SHP-004, Shenzhen to Antwerp, is on plan.
Drafted a reply to Pieter Claes, Kempen Electronics.
MEDU-1774390 (electronics) is on the water on
Asia → Suez → Antwerp, discharging at Antwerp.
What is waiting for my approval?
14 live · Planner scripted · TMS link demo
watches 60 sources, decides reroute or hold
reads every mail, routes it to its owner
8 agents, in the order a shipment lives
Opens the booking from the mail
Checks each field on the B/L
Checks the bill against the rate
checks every output against the customer's rules

svg.text: Ask the desk anything. Every step recorded, and approved by you.

g.text: Automates the desk. Acts before the route breaks.
